name: channelComp
stmt:
noncomputable def channelComp (K : Fin k → Fin l → ℝ) (L : Fin l → Fin m → ℝ) :
    Fin k → Fin m → ℝ
proof: fun a c => ∑ b, K a b * L b c

name: channelComp_row_sum
stmt:
lemma channelComp_row_sum (K : Fin k → Fin l → ℝ) (L : Fin l → Fin m → ℝ)
    (hKr : ∀ a, ∑ b, K a b = 1) (hLr : ∀ b, ∑ c, L b c = 1) :
    ∀ a, ∑ c, channelComp K L a c = 1
proof:
by
  intro a
  simp only [channelComp]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  have h : ∀ b, ∑ c, K a b * L b c = K a b := by
    intro b
    rw [← Finset.mul_sum, hLr b, mul_one]
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun b _ => h b), hKr a]

name: channelComp_pos
stmt:
lemma channelComp_pos [Nonempty (Fin l)] (K : Fin k → Fin l → ℝ) (L : Fin l → Fin m → ℝ)
    (hK : ∀ a b, 0 < K a b) (hL : ∀ b c, 0 < L b c) :
    ∀ a c, 0 < channelComp K L a c
proof:
by
  intro a c
  simp only [channelComp]
  exact Finset.sum_pos (fun b _ => mul_pos (hK a b) (hL b c)) Finset.univ_nonempty

name: channelPush_comp
doc: 信道推前的函子性：(p·K)·L = p·(K∘L)。
stmt:
lemma channelPush_comp (K : Fin k → Fin l → ℝ) (L : Fin l → Fin m → ℝ) (p : Fin k → ℝ) :
    channelPush (channelComp K L) p = channelPush L (channelPush K p)
proof:
by
  funext c
  have hL : ∑ a, p a * (∑ b, K a b * L b c)
      = ∑ b, ∑ a, p a * (K a b * L b c) := by
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun a _ => by rw [Finset.mul_sum]), Finset.sum_comm]
  have hR : ∑ b, (∑ a, p a * K a b) * L b c
      = ∑ b, ∑ a, (p a * K a b) * L b c :=
    Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun b _ => by rw [Finset.sum_mul])
  simp only [channelPush, channelComp]
  rw [hL, hR]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro b _
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro a _
  ring

name: channelPush_pos
stmt:
lemma channelPush_pos [Nonempty (Fin k)] (K : Fin k → Fin l → ℝ) (p : Fin k → ℝ)
    (hp : ∀ a, 0 < p a) (hK : ∀ a b, 0 < K a b) (b : Fin l) : 0 < channelPush K p b
proof:
by
  simp only [channelPush]
  exact Finset.sum_pos (fun a _ => mul_pos (hp a) (hK a b)) Finset.univ_nonempty

name: channelPush_sum
stmt:
lemma channelPush_sum (K : Fin k → Fin l → ℝ) (p : Fin k → ℝ)
    (hKr : ∀ a, ∑ b, K a b = 1) (hps : ∑ a, p a = 1) :
    ∑ b, channelPush K p b = 1
proof:
by
  simp only [channelPush]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  have h : ∀ a, ∑ b, p a * K a b = p a := by
    intro a
    rw [← Finset.mul_sum, hKr a, mul_one]
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun a _ => h a), hps]

name: dp_chain
stmt:
theorem dp_chain (p q : Fin k → ℝ) (K : Fin k → Fin l → ℝ) (L : Fin l → Fin m → ℝ)
    (hp : ∀ a, 0 < p a) (hps : ∑ a, p a = 1)
    (hq : ∀ a, 0 < q a) (hqs : ∑ a, q a = 1)
    (hK : ∀ a b, 0 < K a b) (hKr : ∀ a, ∑ b, K a b = 1)
    (hL : ∀ b c, 0 < L b c) (hLr : ∀ b, ∑ c, L b c = 1) :
    kl (channelPush (channelComp K L) p) (channelPush (channelComp K L) q) ≤ kl p q
proof:
by
  have hk : k ≠ 0 := by
    rintro rfl
    simp at hps
  haveI : Nonempty (Fin k) := ⟨⟨0, Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hk⟩⟩
  rw [channelPush_comp K L p, channelPush_comp K L q]
  have hpK : ∀ b, 0 < channelPush K p b := fun b => channelPush_pos K p hp hK b
  have hpKs : ∑ b, channelPush K p b = 1 := channelPush_sum K p hKr hps
  have hqK : ∀ b, 0 < channelPush K q b := fun b => channelPush_pos K q hq hK b
  have hqKs : ∑ b, channelPush K q b = 1 := channelPush_sum K q hKr hqs
  calc kl (channelPush L (channelPush K p)) (channelPush L (channelPush K q))
      ≤ kl (channelPush K p) (channelPush K q) :=
        dp_inequality (channelPush K p) (channelPush K q) L hpK hpKs hqK hqKs hL hLr
    _ ≤ kl p q := dp_inequality p q K hp hps hq hqs hK hKr

name: channelPush_zero_col
doc: 若第 b 列整列为零，则推前分布的第 b 分量为零。
stmt:
lemma channelPush_zero_col (K : Fin k → Fin l → ℝ) (p : Fin k → ℝ) (b : Fin l)
    (h : ∀ a, K a b = 0) : channelPush K p b = 0
proof:
by
  simp only [channelPush]
  exact Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun a _ => by rw [h a, mul_zero])

name: dp_zero_column_term
doc: 零列的 KL 项为零：推前分布两侧在该分量都为零。
stmt:
lemma dp_zero_column_term (K : Fin k → Fin l → ℝ) (p q : Fin k → ℝ) (b : Fin l)
    (h : ∀ a, K a b = 0) :
    channelPush K p b = 0 ∧ channelPush K q b = 0 ∧
      channelPush K p b * Real.log (channelPush K p b / channelPush K q b) = 0
proof:
by
  have hp := channelPush_zero_col K p b h
  have hq := channelPush_zero_col K q b h
  refine ⟨hp, hq, ?_⟩
  rw [hp, zero_div, Real.log_zero, mul_zero]

name: ratioConstant
doc:
比值在信道的每个纤维上常值：
   对任意 b 与任意两个 K_{·b} > 0 的输入 a、a'，有 p_a/q_a = p_{a'}/q_{a'}。
stmt: def ratioConstant (K : Fin k → Fin l → ℝ) (p q : Fin k → ℝ) : Prop
proof: ∀ b a a', 0 < K a b → 0 < K a' b → p a / q a = p a' / q a'

name: ratioFactorized
doc: 等价表述：存在 c : Fin l → ℝ，使 K_{ab} > 0 时 p_a/q_a = c_b（「因子化」）。
stmt: def ratioFactorized (K : Fin k → Fin l → ℝ) (p q : Fin k → ℝ) : Prop
proof: ∃ c : Fin l → ℝ, ∀ a b, 0 < K a b → p a / q a = c b

name: ratioConstant_iff_ratioFactorized
doc: 两种表述等价（K 严格正、Fin k 非空时；否则空纤维赋予任意常数）。
stmt:
lemma ratioConstant_iff_ratioFactorized [Nonempty (Fin k)] (K : Fin k → Fin l → ℝ)
    (p q : Fin k → ℝ) (hK : ∀ a b, 0 < K a b) :
    ratioConstant K p q ↔ ratioFactorized K p q
proof:
by
  constructor
  · intro hrc
    refine ⟨fun b => p (Classical.arbitrary (Fin k)) / q (Classical.arbitrary (Fin k)), ?_⟩
    intro a b _
    exact hrc b a (Classical.arbitrary (Fin k)) (hK a b) (hK _ b)
  · rintro ⟨c, hc⟩ b a a' ha ha'
    rw [hc a b ha, hc a' b ha']

name: dp_eq_of_ratio_constant
doc:
**DPI 等号刻画的（后向）方向**：比值在纤维上常值 ⟹ KL 不变。
证明：由常值性 (pK)_b = c_b·(qK)_b（c_b = p_{a₀}/q_{a₀}），故
(pK)_b/(qK)_b = c_b 与 b 无关地等于一个固定常数 c；
KL(pK‖qK) = Σ_b (pK)_b·log c = log c·Σ_b (pK)_b = log c，
KL(p‖q) = Σ_a p_a·log(p_a/q_a) = log c·Σ_a p_a = log c。两者相等。
stmt:
theorem dp_eq_of_ratio_constant (p q : Fin k → ℝ) (K : Fin k → Fin l → ℝ)
    (hp : ∀ a, 0 < p a) (hps : ∑ a, p a = 1)
    (hq : ∀ a, 0 < q a) (hqs : ∑ a, q a = 1)
    (hK : ∀ a b, 0 < K a b) (hKr : ∀ a, ∑ b, K a b = 1)
    (hrc : ratioConstant K p q) :
    kl (channelPush K p) (channelPush K q) = kl p q
proof:
by
  have hk : k ≠ 0 := by
    rintro rfl
    simp at hps
  haveI : Nonempty (Fin k) := ⟨⟨0, Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hk⟩⟩
  have hl : l ≠ 0 := by
    rintro rfl
    have h := hKr (Classical.arbitrary (Fin k))
    simp at h
  obtain ⟨b0⟩ : Nonempty (Fin l) := ⟨⟨0, Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hl⟩⟩
         
  have hc : ∀ a, p a / q a = p (Classical.arbitrary (Fin k)) / q (Classical.arbitrary (Fin k)) :=
    fun a => hrc b0 a (Classical.arbitrary (Fin k)) (hK a b0) (hK _ b0)
                      
  have hratio : ∀ b, channelPush K p b
      = (p (Classical.arbitrary (Fin k)) / q (Classical.arbitrary (Fin k))) * channelPush K q b := by
    intro b
    simp only [channelPush]
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro a _
    have h1 : p a
        = (p (Classical.arbitrary (Fin k)) / q (Classical.arbitrary (Fin k))) * q a :=
      calc p a = (p a / q a) * q a := (div_mul_cancel₀ (p a) (ne_of_gt (hq a))).symm
        _ = (p (Classical.arbitrary (Fin k)) / q (Classical.arbitrary (Fin k))) * q a := by
              rw [hc a]
    rw [h1]
    ring
  have hqK : ∀ b, 0 < channelPush K q b := fun b => channelPush_pos K q hq hK b
  have hpK : ∀ b, 0 < channelPush K p b := fun b => channelPush_pos K p hp hK b
  have hpKs : ∑ b, channelPush K p b = 1 := channelPush_sum K p hKr hps
  rw [kl_as_sum_log_ratio (channelPush K p) (channelPush K q) hpK hqK, kl_as_sum_log_ratio p q hp hq]
  have hL : ∑ b, channelPush K p b * Real.log (channelPush K p b / channelPush K q b)
      = Real.log

name: dpGap
stmt: noncomputable def dpGap (K : Fin k → Fin l → ℝ) (p q : Fin k → ℝ) : ℝ
proof: kl p q - kl (channelPush K p) (channelPush K q)

name: dp_gap_nonneg
stmt:
theorem dp_gap_nonneg (p q : Fin k → ℝ) (K : Fin k → Fin l → ℝ)
    (hp : ∀ a, 0 < p a) (hps : ∑ a, p a = 1)
    (hq : ∀ a, 0 < q a) (hqs : ∑ a, q a = 1)
    (hK : ∀ a b, 0 < K a b) (hKr : ∀ a, ∑ b, K a b = 1) :
    0 ≤ dpGap K p q
proof:
by
  have h := dp_inequality p q K hp hps hq hqs hK hKr
  unfold dpGap
  linarith

name: dp_strict_of_collapse
doc:
**DPI 的严格下降实例**：单输出信道（l = 1，K ≡ 1）把任意分布探塌为同一点分布，
    故 KL(pK‖qK) = 0；只要 p ≠ q，就有 KL(p‖q) > 0，于是 KL 严格下降。

这是「DPI 一般不是等号」的清晰证据，也是等号刻画正向方向的一个反例锚点。
stmt:
theorem dp_strict_of_collapse {k : ℕ} (p q : Fin k → ℝ)
    (hp : ∀ a, 0 < p a) (hps : ∑ a, p a = 1)
    (hq : ∀ a, 0 < q a) (hqs : ∑ a, q a = 1) (hpq : p ≠ q) :
    kl (channelPush (fun (_ : Fin k) (_ : Fin 1) => (1 : ℝ)) p)
        (channelPush (fun (_ : Fin k) (_ : Fin 1) => (1 : ℝ)) q) < kl p q
proof:
by
  have hcolp : channelPush (fun (_ : Fin k) (_ : Fin 1) => (1 : ℝ)) p = fun _ => (1 : ℝ) := by
    funext b
    simp only [channelPush, mul_one]
    exact hps
  have hcolq : channelPush (fun (_ : Fin k) (_ : Fin 1) => (1 : ℝ)) q = fun _ => (1 : ℝ) := by
    funext b
    simp only [channelPush, mul_one]
    exact hqs
  rw [hcolp, hcolq,
    kl_eq_zero_of_eq (fun _ : Fin 1 => (1 : ℝ)) (fun _ : Fin 1 => (1 : ℝ)) rfl]
  have hpos := kl_pos_of_ne p q hp hps hq hqs hpq
  linarith

end Lattice

name: logsum_eq_imp_ratio_one
doc:
**log-sum 函数的等号情形（核心工具）**。

设 `z, z' : ι → ℝ` 严格正，且 log-sum 不等式取等：
`(Σz)·log((Σz)/(Σz')) = Σ z·log(z/z')`。则对每个 i 有 `z_i·(Σz') = z'_i·(Σz)`，
即 `A_i := z_i·(Σz')/(z'_i·(Σz)) = 1`。

证明：令 `m = Σz`、`r = Σz'`、`A_i = z_i·r/(z'_i·m) > 0`。由 `RealDataProcessing.logsum_le`
证明内部的恒等式
  `Σ z_i·log A_i = (Σ z_i·log(z_i/z'_i)) − m·log(m/r)`，
取等给出 `Σ z_i·log A_i = 0`。另一方面
  `(A_i = 1) ⟺ log A_i = 1 − A_i⁻¹`（`RealEqualityCharacterization.log_eq_one_sub_inv_iff`），
且每项 `z_i·(1 − A_i⁻¹) ≤ z_i·log A_i`、`Σ z_i·(1 − A_i⁻¹) = 0`，
故差 `Σ (z_i·log A_i − z_i·(1 − A_i⁻¹)) = 0` 而非负逐项，每项为零；
`z_i > 0` 时 `log A_i = 1 − A_i⁻¹`，于是 `A_i = 1`。
stmt:
lemma logsum_eq_imp_ratio_one {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Nonempty ι] (z z' : ι → ℝ)
    (hz : ∀ i, 0 < z i) (hz' : ∀ i, 0 < z' i)
    (heq : (∑ i, z i) * Real.log ((∑ i, z i) / (∑ i, z' i))
      = ∑ i, z i * Real.log (z i / z' i)) :
    ∀ i, z i * (∑ i, z' i) = z' i * (∑ i, z i)
proof:
by
  have hmpos : 0 < ∑ i, z i :=
    Finset.sum_pos (fun i _ => hz i) Finset.univ_nonempty
  have hrpos : 0 < ∑ i, z' i :=
    Finset.sum_pos (fun i _ => hz' i) Finset.univ_nonempty
  set m : ℝ := ∑ i, z i with hm
  set r : ℝ := ∑ i, z' i with hr
  set A : ι → ℝ := fun i => z i * r / (z' i * m) with hA
  have hApos : ∀ i, 0 < A i :=
    fun i => div_pos (mul_pos (hz i) hrpos) (mul_pos (hz' i) hmpos)
  have hlogA : ∀ i, Real.log (A i)
      = (Real.log (z i) - Real.log (z' i)) + (Real.log r - Real.log m) := by
    intro i
    have h1 : A i = (z i / z' i) * (r / m) := by
      rw [hA]
      exact (div_mul_div_comm (z i) (z' i) r m).symm
    rw [h1, Real.log_mul (ne_of_gt (div_pos (hz i) (hz' i)))
        (ne_of_gt (div_pos hrpos hmpos)),
      Real.log_div (ne_of_gt (hz i)) (ne_of_gt (hz' i)),
      Real.log_div (ne_of_gt hrpos) (ne_of_gt hmpos)]
  have hsplit : ∑ i, z i * Real.log (A i)
      = (∑ i, z i * Real.log (z i / z' i)) + m * (Real.log r - Real.log m) := by
    have hterm : ∀ i, z i * Real.log (A i)
        = z i * Real.log (z i / z' i) + z i * (Real.log r - Real.log m) := by
      intro i
      rw [hlogA i, Real.log_div (ne_of_gt (hz i)) (ne_of_gt (hz' i))]
      ring
    calc ∑ i, z i * Real.log (A i)
        = ∑ i, (z i * Real.log (z i / z' i) + z i * (Real.log r - Real.log m)) :=
          Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => hterm i)
      _ = (∑ i, z i * Real.log (z i / z' i)) + ∑ i, z i * (Real.log r - Real.log m) :=
          Finset.sum_add_distrib
      _ = (∑ i

name: dp_eq_imp_eq
doc:
**DPI 等号刻画的（正向）方向**，强化形式：严格正信道、严格正概率向量下
`KL(pK‖qK) = KL(p‖q) ⟹ p = q`。

证明路线见文件头说明：逐通道 log-sum 取等（`logsum_eq_imp_ratio_one`）给出
`p_a·r_b = q_a·m_b`，对 b 求和并用 `Σ_b r_b = Σ_b m_b = 1` 收缩得 `p_a = q_a`。
stmt:
theorem dp_eq_imp_eq (p q : Fin k → ℝ) (K : Fin k → Fin l → ℝ)
    (hp : ∀ a, 0 < p a) (hps : ∑ a, p a = 1)
    (hq : ∀ a, 0 < q a) (hqs : ∑ a, q a = 1)
    (hK : ∀ a b, 0 < K a b) (hKr : ∀ a, ∑ b, K a b = 1)
    (heq : kl (channelPush K p) (channelPush K q) = kl p q) :
    p = q
proof:
by
  have hk : k ≠ 0 := by
    rintro rfl
    simp at hps
  haveI : Nonempty (Fin k) := ⟨⟨0, Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hk⟩⟩
                
  have hgap_b : ∀ b, 0 ≤ (∑ a, (p a * K a b) * Real.log ((p a * K a b) / (q a * K a b)))
      - (∑ a, p a * K a b) * Real.log ((∑ a, p a * K a b) / (∑ a, q a * K a b)) := by
    intro b
    have h := logsum_le (fun a => p a * K a b) (fun a => q a * K a b)
      (fun a => mul_pos (hp a) (hK a b)) (fun a => mul_pos (hq a) (hK a b))
    linarith
             
  have hsum_gap : ∑ b, ((∑ a, (p a * K a b) * Real.log ((p a * K a b) / (q a * K a b)))
      - (∑ a, p a * K a b) * Real.log ((∑ a, p a * K a b) / (∑ a, q a * K a b))) = 0 := by
    rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    have hR : ∑ b, ∑ a, (p a * K a b) * Real.log ((p a * K a b) / (q a * K a b)) = kl p q := by
      rw [kl_as_sum_log_ratio p q hp hq, Finset.sum_comm]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro a _
      have hdiv : ∀ b, (p a * K a b) / (q a * K a b) = p a / q a := fun b =>
        mul_div_mul_right (p a) (q a) (ne_of_gt (hK a b))
      rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun b _ => by rw [hdiv b])]
      rw [← Finset.sum_mul, ← Finset.mul_sum, hKr a, mul_one]
    have hL : ∑ b, (∑ a, p a * K a b) * Real.log ((∑ a, p a * K a b) / (∑ a, q a * K a b))
        = kl (channelPush K p) (channelPush K q) := by
      rw [kl_as_sum_log_ratio (channelPush K p) (channelPush K q)
        (fun b => channelPush_pos K p hp hK b)
        (fun b => channelPush_pos K q hq hK b)]
      simp only [channelPush

name: dp_eq_imp_ratio_constant
doc:
**DPI 等号刻画的（正向）方向**：严格正信道下 KL 不变 ⟹
`RealDPIComplete.ratioConstant K p q`（比值 `p_a/q_a` 在每个信道的纤维上常值）。

由强化定理 `dp_eq_imp_eq`（得 `p = q`）平凡推出。
stmt:
theorem dp_eq_imp_ratio_constant (p q : Fin k → ℝ) (K : Fin k → Fin l → ℝ)
    (hp : ∀ a, 0 < p a) (hps : ∑ a, p a = 1)
    (hq : ∀ a, 0 < q a) (hqs : ∑ a, q a = 1)
    (hK : ∀ a b, 0 < K a b) (hKr : ∀ a, ∑ b, K a b = 1)
    (heq : kl (channelPush K p) (channelPush K q) = kl p q) :
    ratioConstant K p q
proof:
by
  have hpq : p = q := dp_eq_imp_eq p q K hp hps hq hqs hK hKr heq
  intro b a a' _ _
  rw [hpq]
  rw [div_self (ne_of_gt (hq a)), div_self (ne_of_gt (hq a'))]

name: dp_eq_iff_ratio_constant
doc:
**DPI 等号刻画的完整 iff**（正向 + 后向）：严格正信道、严格正概率向量下
`KL(pK‖qK) = KL(p‖q) ⟺ ratioConstant K p q`。

正向是 `dp_eq_imp_ratio_constant`，后向是 `RealDPIComplete.dp_eq_of_ratio_constant`。
stmt:
theorem dp_eq_iff_ratio_constant (p q : Fin k → ℝ) (K : Fin k → Fin l → ℝ)
    (hp : ∀ a, 0 < p a) (hps : ∑ a, p a = 1)
    (hq : ∀ a, 0 < q a) (hqs : ∑ a, q a = 1)
    (hK : ∀ a b, 0 < K a b) (hKr : ∀ a, ∑ b, K a b = 1) :
    kl (channelPush K p) (channelPush K q) = kl p q ↔ ratioConstant K p q
proof:
⟨dp_eq_imp_ratio_constant p q K hp hps hq hqs hK hKr,
   dp_eq_of_ratio_constant p q K hp hps hq hqs hK hKr⟩

end Lattice

name: channelPush
doc: 信道的推前分布：(pK)_b = Σ_a p_a·K_ab。
stmt: noncomputable def channelPush (K : Fin k → Fin l → ℝ) (p : Fin k → ℝ) : Fin l → ℝ
proof: fun b => ∑ a, p a * K a b

name: markov_row_sum
doc: 每行和为 1（行随机）的记号性引理（信道公理）。
stmt:
lemma markov_row_sum (K : Fin k → Fin l → ℝ) (hKrow : ∀ a, ∑ b, K a b = 1) (a : Fin k) :
    ∑ b, K a b = 1
proof: hKrow a

name: logsum_le
stmt:
lemma logsum_le {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Nonempty ι] (z z' : ι → ℝ)
    (hz : ∀ i, 0 < z i) (hz' : ∀ i, 0 < z' i) :
    (∑ i, z i) * Real.log ((∑ i, z i) / (∑ i, z' i))
      ≤ ∑ i, z i * Real.log (z i / z' i)
proof:
by
  have hmpos : 0 < ∑ i, z i :=

name: dp_inequality
stmt:
theorem dp_inequality (p q : Fin k → ℝ) (K : Fin k → Fin l → ℝ)
    (hp : ∀ a, 0 < p a) (hps : ∑ a, p a = 1)
    (hq : ∀ a, 0 < q a) (hqs : ∑ a, q a = 1)
    (hK : ∀ a b, 0 < K a b) (hKrow : ∀ a, ∑ b, K a b = 1) :
    kl (channelPush K p) (channelPush K q) ≤ kl p q
proof:
by
  have hexp : ∃ a, p a ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra h
    push_neg at h
    have hz : ∑ a, p a = 0 := Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun a _ => h a)
    rw [hps] at hz
    norm_num at hz
  have hexq : ∃ a, q a ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra h
    push_neg at h
    have hz : ∑ a, q a = 0 := Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun a _ => h a)
    rw [hqs] at hz
    norm_num at hz
  have hk : k ≠ 0 := by
    rintro rfl
    simp at hps
  haveI : Nonempty (Fin k) := ⟨⟨0, Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hk⟩⟩
  have hpK : ∀ b, 0 < channelPush K p b := by
    obtain ⟨a0, ha0⟩ := hexp
    intro b
    have h : 0 < ∑ a, p a * K a b :=
      Finset.sum_pos (fun a _ => mul_pos (hp a) (hK a b)) ⟨a0, Finset.mem_univ a0⟩
    simpa [channelPush] using h
  have hqK : ∀ b, 0 < channelPush K q b := by
    obtain ⟨a0, ha0⟩ := hexq
    intro b
    have h : 0 < ∑ a, q a * K a b :=
      Finset.sum_pos (fun a _ => mul_pos (hq a) (hK a b)) ⟨a0, Finset.mem_univ a0⟩
    simpa [channelPush] using h
  rw [kl_as_sum_log_ratio (channelPush K p) (channelPush K q) hpK hqK,
    kl_as_sum_log_ratio p q hp hq]
  calc ∑ b, channelPush K p b * Real.log (channelPush K p b / channelPush K q b)
      = ∑ b, (∑ a, p a * K a b)
          * Real.log ((∑ a, p a * K a b) / (∑ a, q a * K a b)) := by
        simp only [channelPush]
    _ ≤ ∑ b, ∑ a, (p a * K a b) * Real.log ((p a * K a b) / (q a * K a b)) := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro b _
        exact logsum_le (fun a => p a * K a b) (fun a => q a * K a b)
          (fun a => mul_pos (hp a) (hK a b

name: tv_eq_sum_abs
stmt:
lemma tv_eq_sum_abs (p q : Fin k → ℝ) (hp : ∀ a, 0 < p a) :
    tv p q = ∑ a, |q a - p a|
proof:
by
  unfold tv fDivergence
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro a _
  have h2 : p a * (q a / p a - 1) = q a - p a := by
    field_simp [ne_of_gt (hp a)]
  calc p a * |q a / p a - 1| = |p a * (q a / p a - 1)| := by
        rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos (hp a)]
    _ = |q a - p a| := by rw [h2]

name: tv_data_processing
stmt:
theorem tv_data_processing (p q : Fin k → ℝ) (K : Fin k → Fin l → ℝ)
    (hp : ∀ a, 0 < p a) (hps : ∑ a, p a = 1)
    (hK : ∀ a b, 0 < K a b) (hKrow : ∀ a, ∑ b, K a b = 1) :
    tv (channelPush K p) (channelPush K q) ≤ tv p q
proof:
by
  have hexp : ∃ a, p a ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra h
    push_neg at h
    have hz : ∑ a, p a = 0 := Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun a _ => h a)
    rw [hps] at hz
    norm_num at hz
  obtain ⟨a0, ha0⟩ := hexp
  have hpK : ∀ b, 0 < channelPush K p b := by
    intro b
    have h : 0 < ∑ a, p a * K a b :=
      Finset.sum_pos (fun a _ => mul_pos (hp a) (hK a b)) ⟨a0, Finset.mem_univ a0⟩
    simpa [channelPush] using h
  rw [tv_eq_sum_abs (channelPush K p) (channelPush K q) hpK, tv_eq_sum_abs p q hp]
  calc ∑ b, |channelPush K q b - channelPush K p b|
      = ∑ b, |∑ a, (q a - p a) * K a b| := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro b _
        congr 1
        simp only [channelPush]
        rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro a _
        ring
    _ ≤ ∑ b, ∑ a, |q a - p a| * K a b := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro b _
        calc |∑ a, (q a - p a) * K a b| ≤ ∑ a, |(q a - p a) * K a b| := by
              simpa using (Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs (s := Finset.univ)
                (f := fun a => (q a - p a) * K a b))
          _ ≤ ∑ a, |q a - p a| * K a b := by
              apply Finset.sum_le_sum
              intro a _
              rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (le_of_lt (hK a b))]
    _ = ∑ a, |q a - p a| := by
        rw [Finset.sum_comm]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro a _
        rw [← Finset.mul_sum, hKrow a, mul_one]
